workshops.title: AI Toolkit for Doctors
workshops.tagline: Two evenings with ChatGPT and Claude — the fastest way in
workshops.for_whom: Doctors, residents and medical students who have not yet used ChatGPT or Claude seriously in their work.

workshops.title: Build Your First Medical App: Web and Android
workshops.tagline: One evening, no code — a web app and an Android app you built yourself
workshops.for_whom: Any doctor who has had an app idea and assumed code was the wall. Nothing is assumed and nothing needs to be attended first.

workshops.title: Clinical App Building with AI: From Idea to Prototype
workshops.tagline: Two evenings with a real coding agent — one app rebuilt, one built from scratch
workshops.for_whom: Doctors with an idea and no development background. You do not need to have attended the first workshop — that app is sent to every registrant beforehand, so everybody starts from the same place.

workshops.title: AI in Digital Pathology
workshops.tagline: Digital pathology without a whole-slide scanner
workshops.for_whom: Pathologists, PG trainees, laboratory directors and technologists. No scanner and no coding assumed.
